description: List the build rules this project has declared, with the id needed to remove one. Shows which rules ride every build and which are scoped to a single module.

module.description: Optional: show only the rules that would apply to a build in this module (project-wide rules plus that module's own).

project.description: Project id (UUID) or slug to target for THIS call only. Must be a project on your account.

name: convention_list
